hypothesis: Replacing only matched no-transform supervision with fixed-turn rotation supervision improves fixed-turn exact-grid accuracy from the V7 start while preserving marker-binding and no-transform capability.
independent_sentinel: UNAVAILABLE_NO_ELIGIBLE_FROZEN_COHORT_IDENTIFIED; this protocol cannot claim independent generalization.

scientific_design.primary_estimand: Treatment minus control fixed-turn exact-grid accuracy, paired by 48 canonical bases across four turns; 10,000 canonical-base bootstrap replicates.
scientific_design.promotion_rule: At least 8 additional correct episodes of 192 and bootstrap 95% CI lower bound greater than zero.
scientific_design.treatment: 96 matched fixed-turn rotation supervision slots plus 288 byte-identical no-transform protected-replay slots

why_existing_evidence_is_insufficient: The E04 no-update measurement established an atomic rotation deficit but cannot establish whether targeted supervised repair causes improvement or harms protected capabilities.
